# awx_notification_template_irc (Resource)

Manages an AWX `IRC` (`irc`) notification template with first-class typed configuration attributes. Equivalent to `awx_notification_template` with `notification_type = "irc"`, but with per-field schema validation and sensitivity instead of a JSON `notification_configuration` string.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of this notification template.
- `nickname` (String) IRC Nick.
- `organization` (Number) Organization this notification template belongs to.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) IRC Server Password.
- `port` (Number) IRC Server Port.
- `server` (String) IRC Server Address.
- `targets` (List of String) Destination Channels or Users.
- `use_ssl` (Boolean) SSL Connection.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Optional description of this notification template.
- `messages` (String) Optional custom messages for this notification template, as a JSON object.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Database ID of this notification template.
- `notification_type` (String) AWX notification type, fixed by this resource.
